run_system_check: run the SystemCheckCommand to check system software, kernel config, and hardware configurations
check_system_software: run the system_software method to report BIOS version, NIC vendor, and BMC firmware details
check_kernel_config: run the kernel_config method to report kernel version, SELinux status, NVME-TCP module, and THP status
check_hardware_config: run the hardware_config method to report NUMA nodes, CXL presence, boost status, memory speed, and SMT
get_cpuinfo: call get_cpuinfo to parse lscpu output and return a dictionary of CPU configuration key-value pairs
